title: Annuaire — Missions Diplomatiques et Consulats
producer: Ministère des Affaires Étrangères, de la Coopération Africaine et des Marocains Résidant à l'Étranger (MAECAMRE)
acquisition: Institutional contact fields extracted from the official ministry directory.
limitations: Snapshot of the French directory; completeness and operational freshness are unverified.
Public website content has no identified open-data license. Written redistribution permission has not been obtained.
Officials' names, personal email addresses and identified mobile contacts are excluded.
Phone values remain as displayed when ambiguous or invalid; e164 is null. Formatting does not prove reachability.
Missing fields remain null or empty. Email, coordinates and consular jurisdiction are not available in this snapshot.
Den Bosch duplicate panels are merged. Source classification errors and suspect contacts are flagged.
Website links are source-provided and have not been independently verified.
related_dataset_note: Separate data.gov.ma dataset reviewed for comparison; it was not used to produce this snapshot.
